about_short_description.short_description: White Helmet provides AI and computer vision technologies for tracking, inspection, and digital documentation of construction sites.

product.name: WhiteHelmet Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for managing and monitoring construction projects with real-time progress tracking, digital documentation, and collaboration tools.

product.name: WhiteHelmet Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application for capturing construction site progress and automatically uploading data to the cloud for reporting and collaboration.

product.name: 360° Live Virtual Visit (360 LVV)
product.description: A live streaming service providing immersive 360-degree virtual tours of construction sites for remote inspection and collaboration.

product.name: Progress Tracking
product.description: A computer vision and machine learning-based system to monitor, measure, and compare construction progress against BIM data over time.

product.name: Observation Tool
product.description: A digital tool for managing punch lists, snag tracking, issue recording, and aligning with RFI and NCR documentation to support quality control.

product.name: BIM Model Comparison
product.description: A feature that imports BIM 360 Docs assets to compare BIM models with actual construction progress within the WhiteHelmet platform.
